meta.title: Madison County — the money trail
meta.note: This is the county's 2026 budget as filed with the state: Ordinance No. 2025-20 and the January 2026 budget detail report it adopts, using the report's "Original Budget" column. The county moves money between its own funds; the budget says $1,070,873.58 of the $20,809,465.21 total is these transfers, so those dollars appear in two funds. Without them the county budget is $19,738,591.63.
